sources.entry: Seed Imagine - Browser-based AI workspace for text-to-image and photo-to-video creative assets. #freemium

summary.name: Seed Imagine
summary.one_liner: Seed Imagine is a browser-based AI workspace for generating images and videos from text prompts and reference images, with access to several third-party image and video models.
use_cases: Generating product photos for online stores and ads
Animating a still image into a short video
Creating short videos from text prompts
Restyling or editing existing images with AI
Upscaling images for print or ecommerce
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a browser-based workspace combining an AI image generator and AI video generator. Users can create images from text prompts, edit or restyle existing images with a reference, and generate videos from text or by animating a reference image. Listed tools include an image upscaler, watermark remover, and background remover. The page says users can choose among several models, including Seedance 2.5, Veo 3.1, GPT Image 2, and Nano Banana, with output controls such as aspect ratio, resolution, and video duration. Credits are used for generations, and the page says the web app works in mobile browsers.
notable: Single workspace for text-to-image, image-to-image, text-to-video and image-to-video
Access to multiple third-party AI models (Seedance, Veo, GPT Image, Nano Banana, Kling, Hailuo) via a credit system
Failed generations are automatically refunded on paid plans, per the page
caveats: Free tier gives daily credits only; paid plans start at $23.90/month on annual billing ($29.90 monthly for the entry plan)
Credit cost varies by model, output settings and whether the output is image or video
Generation time varies by model, resolution, duration and demand
